propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by AWS Bedrock Guardrail or model content policy, the operator-facing message incorrectly states 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the actual cause (content-policy intervention).
The finish_reason='content_filter' value is available on LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage but is not threaded to message_for() to enable condition-specific messaging.

A content-filter block is correctly classified as ResolutionClass.CHANGE_INPUT (non-retryable), but the generic CHANGE_INPUT message misleads operators toward size/format remedies rather than policy reconsideration.
The fix must preserve backward compatibility and not alter resolution classification, exit codes, or telemetry — only refine the operator-facing diagnostic message.
